findings.detail: Issuer-name extraction appends or absorbs investment text, suppressing matches between persistent current and prior schedule issuers.

rationale: Class 3 continuity flag. The filing schedule total is internally consistent at $8,632.315 million current versus $8,108.654 million prior, and paired raw schedule rows show the same issuer and instrument persisting across periods. Truck-Lite is present at table 8 row 4 and table 14 row 5; the paired schedules likewise show many other unchanged issuers. The extracted holding instead names this issuer 'Truck-Lite Co., LLC Investment', demonstrating that investment-column text leaked into issuer_name. Therefore the reported 29/88 continuity is a pipeline issuer-name extraction/normalization error rather than genuine turnover. The schedule total is contextual; grounding rests on the paired row citations.
